Independently retrieved Casio Japan/Europe pages now validate the solar/radio operation, 100 m resistance, mineral glass, shock resistance, calendar, and +/-15-seconds-per-month fallback accuracy; exact-family replacement records resolve the case-side interface as a proprietary pushpin/special mount. targets.coverageRationale: Independent exact-reference review validates the current EUR 390 Augsburg 39 article 861988 on its 81.5 g brown riveted calf-leather configuration, 39 x 11.55 x 46.5 mm geometry, 18 mm spring-bar interface, LACO 2S regulation of 0/+25 seconds per day, 42-hour reserve, 50 m resistance, sapphire, and no-date operation. A July 2026 verified purchaser identifies the current black Augsburg 39 configuration and reports excellent legibility through morning, with Laco publicly concurring; this establishes strong lume without treating C3 material alone as a performance grade. The compact pilot row adds a second candidate to 12 sparse 300_500, studio, workhorse-mechanical, time-only cells.
